core_findings: The official Atlanta Police Department page identifies the Airport Section as the local law enforcement unit providing police services for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, specifically including terminals, concourses, and parking lots.

Official airport emergency-management material shows airport operations coordinate law enforcement, fire, and EMS with City of Atlanta, Fulton County, Clayton County, College Park, and Forest Park, which is inconsistent with a simple single-place or single-county proxy.

Official airport legal and fact-sheet materials show the airport is a bounded airport property owned and operated by the City of Atlanta Department of Aviation and located in Fulton and Clayton Counties.
Official Atlanta airport ordinances expressly recognize airport police personnel and airport-specific traffic enforcement within the airfield and restricted airport operations areas.

Because the policing function is airport-facility-specific and the airport is a bounded multijurisdiction property, the right production treatment is a custom airport footprint rather than absorption into Atlanta city or localization to a single county.

footprint_assessment.facility_owner_operator: City of Atlanta Department of Aviation
multijurisdiction_evidence: The Airport Operations Center coordinates with City of Atlanta, Fulton County, Clayton County, College Park, and Forest Park.
Official airport legal material places the airport in both Fulton and Clayton Counties.

atlanta_city_proxy: Atlanta city is too broad; the agency polices airport facilities, not general city territory.
Airport police are airport-specific in both the APD description and the airport ordinance.
single_county_proxy: Official airport legal material places the airport in both Fulton and Clayton Counties.
Using only Fulton or only Clayton would misstate the facility footprint.
absorb_into_primary_jurisdiction: Absorbing this case into Atlanta would erase a distinct bounded airport policing layer that is materially different from ordinary city patrol geography.
The airport has its own dedicated police budget and airport-specific ordinance framework.

implementation_recommendation.custom_footprint_description: Use the Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport property footprint rather than a municipal or county proxy.
implementation_recommendation.secondary_note: If custom footprint support is temporarily unavailable, keep this row in overlap rather than collapsing it into Atlanta city or a single county.
